title: Make a game
start.heading: How do you want to start?
start.text: Both ways end in the Builder. You can change anything there.
start.guideText: Pick a game type, a world and characters in six quick steps.
start.directText: Go straight to the Builder and describe your game in your own words.
else.title: Something else
else.label: Tell us your idea
else.packNote: This is not in our packs, so the Builder will make it from scratch. It may look simpler.
steps.type.title: What kind of game?
steps.type.hint: Pick one. You can change it later.
steps.type.placeholder: Like: a maze, a cooking game, a race
steps.look.title: 2D or 3D?
steps.world.title: Where does it happen?
steps.world.hint: Pick a world, or dream up your own.
steps.world.placeholder: Like: inside a volcano, a candy planet
steps.chars.title: Who is in it?
steps.chars.hint: Pick as many as you like.
steps.chars.placeholder: Like: a penguin chef, a robot dog
steps.learn.title: What should it teach?
steps.learn.hint: Pick as many as you like.
steps.learn.placeholder: Like: times tables to 12, the water cycle
steps.extras.title: Anything to add?
